name: print-social-frosted-glass-card-over-family-kitchen-photo
title: Playful family photo with a frosted glass frame and a white blob-shaped message card
whatItIs: A candid kitchen photo of a father, child and two blurred family members. A glass rounded frame highlights the centre, with a hashtag and logo pill, and a white gradient blob card with headline 'Less managing. More living.', an advisor avatar and a navy CTA.
whatItMeans: Warm and human; the glass frame focuses the moment and the blob card feels friendly.
techniques: Frame the focus area with a glass border and blur the outside.
Use a blob-shaped card with a notched edge.
Pair a two-line bold headline with a short line.
Add an avatar and name for trust.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent border isolating part of a photo.
A card with soft irregular edges.
Blurring everything outside the focus area.
